title: Why attention is O(n^2) and how Flash/Sage fix the memory

questions.q: According to the lesson, what is the primary memory bottleneck in standard attention for long sequences?
options: The storage of the Q, K, and V matrices
The storage of the n x n score matrix S
The convolutional layers
The output matrix O
questions.answer: The storage of the n x n score matrix S
questions.why: The lesson states that 'the memory footprint is O(n^2)' and 'this n x n matrix becomes the dominant memory consumer' because it must be stored in HBM before softmax.

questions.q: In the lab results, what was the peak memory usage for the attention scores when using a tile size of 256 for a 64k sequence?
options: 2 MB
32 MB
50 MB
questions.why: The lab result `RESULT tiled_mem_64k_mb = 32` explicitly states that using a tile size of 256 reduces peak memory usage to 32 MB.

questions.q: How does Sage/Quantized Attention (specifically `attention_comfy_kitchen_int8`) improve performance in ComfyUI?
options: By reducing the sequence length n
By changing the mathematical formula of softmax
By reducing the precision of Q, K, V from fp16 to int8, halving memory bandwidth requirements
By removing the need for the V matrix
questions.answer: By reducing the precision of Q, K, V from fp16 to int8, halving memory bandwidth requirements
questions.why: The lesson explains that this method 'reduces the precision of Q, K, V from fp16 to int8. This halves the memory bandwidth requirement and allows more tiles to fit in SRAM'.

questions.q: What is the function of `optimized_attention_for_device` in ComfyUI?
options: It manually forces the use of `attention_basic` for all models
It selects the best attention backend based on available hardware and libraries
It calculates the exact memory footprint of the n x n matrix
It implements the convolutional layers for SDXL
questions.answer: It selects the best attention backend based on available hardware and libraries
questions.why: The lesson states that `optimized_attention_for_device` 'selects the best backend based on your hardware. It checks for available libraries and registers them'.

options: It optimizes for data movement by keeping computation on on-chip SRAM and avoiding storing the full n x n matrix in HBM
It uses integer arithmetic instead of floating-point
It reduces the number of tokens in the sequence
It parallelizes the convolutional layers
questions.answer: It optimizes for data movement by keeping computation on on-chip SRAM and avoiding storing the full n x n matrix in HBM
questions.why: The lesson defines IO-awareness as optimizing for data movement, noting that FlashAttention 'never form[s] the full n x n matrix in HBM' and keeps computation on 'fast, small on-chip SRAM'.
